messages.subject: Error: invalid 'times' argument read.capthist
parts:
Dear Group,

I am quite new to using secr and have a problem with the read.capthist function. The following error always appears:

Error in rep(NA, nfield - nvar): invalid 'times' argument  

I have already read about similar problems to this error and tried to apply the given suggestions. Unfortunately it did not help yet. This is my current script:

library(secr)

surmatash <- read.capthist(captfile = "Capture_Surmatash.csv", trapfile = "trap_surmatash_new.csv", detector = "count", fmt = "trapID", skip = 1)

In addtion, I attached my whole script and the capture and trap files as a csv if that helps to figure out the problem. I think that the error is due to the csv files, but so far I have not been able to solve the problem.

Any help is much appreciated. Have a nice day.

Kind regards,
Joshua

messages.subject: Re: Error: invalid 'times' argument read.capthist
parts: You provide files with names that do not match your code, one is empty and another has data in quotes as a single character field. It's up to you to sort this out. If you have trouble, the safe option is to construct plain text files in the recommended format.
